purpose: Fifteen-space full-property reimagination with an individual direction for all 39 listing photographs.
sharedConstraints: Treat the listing photo as the edit target and preserve fixed architecture, camera angle, doors, windows, flooring, ceiling, trim and natural-light direction.
Keep realistic scale, clear walking and emergency-exit paths, door swings, window access, HVAC and baseboard heat.
Use rounded, washable furniture and anchor storage, aquarium stands and other tip-over hazards to suitable structure.
Use Islamic influence through restrained arches and geometry; do not generate Arabic, Qur'anic verses, sacred text or imitation calligraphy.
Use only the single lidded aquarium in the family hall and verify plant species before purchase.
Do not include people, faces, names, addresses, readable documents, logos, trademarks or watermarks.

rooms.title: Front exterior — two affordable paint directions
rooms.summary: A paint-first curb-appeal plan that keeps the roof, windows, masonry and structure while adding a calmer palette and simple planting.
plan: First identify the siding material and confirm it is sound and paintable; repair and clean before coating.
The warm-white version gives the largest visual change with a deep-blue door and refreshed trim.
The light-sage version feels closer to nature and stays light enough to reduce heat-risk concerns on paintable vinyl siding.
Retain the existing roof, brick and garage door to control cost; focus spending on preparation and durable exterior coating.
Use modest native-looking foundation plants, mulch and efficient warm exterior lighting.
rooms.prompt: Edit the exact front listing photo using paint and modest landscaping only. Preserve all architecture, roof, windows, doors, driveway and proportions. Show a warm off-white siding palette with refreshed white trim, deep blue door, simple foundation plants and efficient warm exterior light; no structural additions.

alternatives.title: Nature-sage exterior variation
alternatives.summary: Light sage siding, creamy trim and a warm wood-look door create a softer garden-connected exterior.

rooms.variationIntro: Confirm siding material, manufacturer limits and surface condition before choosing a color. Dark paint can be unsuitable for some vinyl siding.

rooms.title: Family hall — sofa, TV and living nature
rooms.summary: A welcoming family hall with mounted TV, washable seating, Islamic geometric art, layered light, plants and the home’s single aquarium.
plan: Use one compact sofa and two movable chairs; retain a direct route from the front door to the stairs.
Mount the TV with concealed cables and keep low closed storage below or beside it.
Use one lidded 15–20 gallon planted aquarium on a purpose-built anchored stand away from direct sunlight.
Choose a washable low-pile rug and warm overhead, task and bias lighting.
Use parlor palm, spider plant or peperomia after verifying the exact species for the household.
rooms.prompt: Edit the exact family-hall listing photo into a calm family room with compact sofa, two chairs, wall-mounted TV with concealed wires, closed storage, one properly supported lidded planted aquarium, washable rug, layered lighting, restrained Islamic geometric wall art without text, and a few verified plants. Preserve architecture and all circulation; no people or readable writing.

alternatives.title: Screen-light family variation
alternatives.summary: More open floor play and lower storage, with the television visually secondary.

rooms.variationIntro: Compare the options against verified room measurements before buying furniture.

rooms.title: Second hall — prayer, reading and storage
rooms.summary: A naturally bright prayer room with separated rug zones, open circulation, compact seating and hidden storage.
plan: Verify qibla direction on site before arranging the individual prayer rugs.
Keep an open aisle between the two rug zones and preserve clear stair access.
Use a small storage sofa or lift-top bench for folded rugs and blankets.
Add low closed book storage and restrained non-text geometric decor.
Place a few verified plants on stable raised surfaces so daylight and paths remain open.
rooms.prompt: Edit the exact vaulted hall photo into a family prayer and reading room with six separated individual prayer rugs, a modest aisle, small storage sofa, low book cabinet, compact seating, restrained non-text Islamic geometry and raised plants. Preserve skylights, windows, stairs and circulation. Do not invent qibla or generate Arabic text.

alternatives.title: Open prayer and reading variation

rooms.title: Kitchen — remove the white refrigerator and add pantry cabinets
rooms.summary: Keep the stainless refrigerator and existing footprint; replace the extra white refrigerator with floor-to-ceiling pantry, drawers and an appliance garage.
plan: Disconnect and dispose of the white refrigerator through an appliance recycler; keep the stainless refrigerator if inspection and energy use are acceptable.
Measure the former refrigerator opening and install a fitted pantry cabinet with deep drawers and adjustable shelves.
Reuse sound cabinet boxes; clean, repair and repaint doors rather than replacing the entire kitchen.
Add ceiling-height cabinet extensions only where they remain reachable and do not interfere with ventilation.
Use LED task lighting, durable pulls and a simple backsplash before considering new counters or moving plumbing.
rooms.prompt: Edit the exact kitchen listing photo. Keep the stainless refrigerator, range, dishwasher, sink, windows, floor and footprint. Remove only the second white refrigerator and replace it with fitted floor-to-ceiling pantry cabinets, deep drawers and an appliance garage. Extend useful upper storage, add efficient task lighting and preserve clear work paths.

alternatives.title: Sage and oak pantry variation
alternatives.summary: Repaint reusable lower cabinets sage and use a light-oak pantry wall for a warmer nature-focused kitchen.

rooms.variationIntro: Both concepts keep one refrigerator and avoid moving plumbing. Price the pantry cabinet separately before considering counters or a full cabinet replacement.

rooms.title: Dining room — six seats, simple storage
rooms.budget: $700–$1,600 new, or less if approved seller pieces are retained
rooms.summary: A durable six-seat dining setup with one closed cabinet and a clear route to the sliding door.
plan: A practical six-seat table sized for the household; avoid a larger formal set.
Washable wood or wipe-clean chairs rather than odor-holding upholstery.
One anchored closed cabinet for serving pieces and school supplies.
Keep the sliding-door path open and preserve comfortable chair pull-out clearance.
Use one restrained geometric runner or wall panel instead of many small decorations.
